answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The knoll is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the grove. By the mesa of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
